I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. The official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was November 3, 2025.

Two sources back that date. Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.

I also told her that her recap says she ran the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. If the coverage tracker needs the operational start date, that's the one to use.
